'''Tainor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Imperial Guard]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Tainor led the forces of the Imperial Guard on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]], and was captured by Republic forces during a raid on the Guard's headquarters in the [[Museum Republica]].
